name: NX4 KOR: Tucson NX4 (Korea)
description: HMG-API add-on for the Korean Tucson NX4 (260902) with a manager app. The app shows the USB install progress and checks HMG-API and the official Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto mod (wireless-carplay-aa) on this car (versions, boot guard, hooks and map, the projection Wi-Fi AP and Wi-Fi part, other Wi-Fi packages), says what blocks wireless projection and what to do, and counts CarPlay connections. It can request a reboot, held back while installing or near the HMG-API boot guard, and asks before the USB installer collects a diagnostic log.
